Card.name: Card
Card.definition: Electronic money product that provides the cardholder with a portable and specialised computer device, which typically contains a microprocessor.

POI.name: POI
POI.definition: Physical or logical card payment terminal containing software and hardware components.

AggregatedEntry.name: Aggregated Entry
AggregatedEntry.definition: Card entry details, based on card transaction aggregated data performed by the account servicer.

PrePaidAccount.name: Pre Paid Account
PrePaidAccount.definition: Prepaid account for the transfer or loading of an amount of money.
